notes.title: And now for something completely different...
notes.notes:
Hey horror fans!

While a part of our team has moved on to do awesome things in the industry around the world, some of us stayed behind and worked on a new project the last 2 years. We founded a small game dev studio and worked on a local multiplayer game called "Chapeau".

Here's a trailer: [previewyoutube=wemDNU3Nok0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wemDNU3Nok0[/previewyoutube]

Today we are released a public Alpha you can play for free, just check out our Discord to get a key: [url=https://discord.gg/KUaZkte]Discord[/url]

We understand that not everyone may be interested in such a change of direction, coming from a horror game, but maybe some of you will enjoy it. :) (It's also to prove to some Insanity reviews that we are actually not that sick in the head ;P)

Have a great day,
Mat

notes.title: Release Day!
notes.notes:
It's release day, hooray!

We are very proud to release our first game on Steam today and hope you can enjoy some truly uncanny and frightening moments in the world we created.

Tell us what you think about the game, the story and how your playthrough went. 

- The Insanity VR/ Threevol Team
